answer: Concrete mechanism: every new identity must escrow a stake into a shared vault before it may submit, and a rotating auditor set keyed to the epoch beacon slashes that bond when an answer fails review. Seat assignment is hashed from the beacon plus the applicant address, so a sybil farm cannot route its clones toward friendly graders. A juniper-thin cluster of fresh keys therefore needs independent attestations it cannot cheaply buy, and a karst-like heap of parked identities drains capital on every slash. Mass registration then costs real money per fake agent instead of minutes of compute.
